learning.title: A profile derived from an observation must carry every operator-authored field forward
learning.trigger: Onboarding publishes an observed (v2) repository profile from a draft profile, or any code rebuilds a profile from parts.
learning.mistake: `deriveRepositoryInspectionConfig` rebuilt the observed profile from the workflow, branches, worktree, fixed policy and rule overrides but dropped `agentBindings`. A draft that bound agents produced an active profile with none, so every run on a fixed-policy profile failed admission with `model_agent_required` and no model-backed preset could start. Unit tests that seeded v2 profiles directly never went through the derivation, so nothing failed until a lane onboarded through the real inspection route.
learning.rule: Treat repository intent (agent bindings, rule overrides) as data to carry forward, not something an observation recomputes. When a profile is rebuilt, spread each authored optional field the same way the overrides are, and prove it with a case that derives from a draft that has the field, re-derives from the observed result, and derives from a draft without it (the field stays absent). Prove the bindings also survive a real onboarding run: create the repository with bindings, onboard it through the inspection route and admit a model step on the result.

verification.requirement: The derived observed profile equals the draft's agent bindings, keeps them when derived again, and has no `agentBindings` key when the draft has none.

learning.boundary: Fixed in apps/server/src/modules/projects/repository-inspect.ts. A profile created before the fix lost its bindings and needs a new profile revision with them.
